title: Ellipsis inside a flex row
summary: Truncation in a flex item also needs min-width: 0, or the item refuses to shrink.
explanation: The name has the usual three truncation declarations, yet without min-width: 0 it would push the date out of the row. A flex item's default minimum width is its content's width, and with nowrap that is the whole unbroken line.
min-width: 0 lets the name shrink below its text, and flex: 1 makes it take the space the date does not need. Now overflow: hidden has something to clip, and the ellipsis appears.
This is the single most common 'my ellipsis does not work' bug.
tryThis: Remove min-width: 0 from .name: the date gets pushed out of the row.
Delete text-overflow: ellipsis from .name: the text is still cut, but mid-letter with no …
Make .row 500px wide: no truncation is needed any more.
